# HyperUI

> Android Jetpack Compose UI component library. Markdown is the authoritative API source; Wasm is only an interactive preview.

- [Complete documentation corpus](./llms-full.txt): all documentation in one plain-text response.
- [Documentation index](./index.md): AI and developer reading order.
- [Getting started](./getting-started.md): dependency and minimum setup.
- [Theme and colors](./theme.md): theme configuration and RGBA color rules.
- [State and architecture](./state-model.md): state ownership and integration boundaries.
- [Component index](./component-index.md): links to every component Markdown page.
- [HTML documentation](./): human-readable website.

Production builds regenerate this index from `vitepress/docs/` and add every Markdown document automatically.
